name: Joe O'Brien
role: Medora blacksmith, partner of Dan McKenzie
bio: Joe O'Brien formed the blacksmithing firm McKenzie & O'Brien with Dan McKenzie in June 1884, and the paper said they were rushed with work. After visiting relatives in Missouri and Iowa in early 1885, he set out overland for Cheyenne at the end of August 1885, and by November 1885 he was at Buffalo Gap in the Black Hills.

moments.label: Formed blacksmith partnership with Dan McKenzie

mentions: Messrs. McKenzie and O'Brien have been overrun with work since the removal of the blacksmith shop.

As may be seen by their card, Messrs. McKenzie & O'Brien have formed a partnership in the blacksmithing business. It would be hard to find two better workmen and we are glad to state that they are rushed with work.
Joe O'Brien will be gone about two months on his eastern trip. Meantime Dan McKenzie is holding down the blacksmith shop.
As soon as Joe O'Brien returns, Dan. McKenzie will take a vacation and visit relatives in the east.
Johnny Goodall is in St. Paul and will return in a few days. Joe O'Brien will come with him. It's ten to one that Johnny don't wear the same head-gear here that he did in St. Paul.
